name: browser-scrape
description: Headless Chromium: reads a page that static requests cannot (JS-rendered, search results), and photographs a page or inline HTML into a PNG — the HTML-to-image path, so a KaTeX formula, a chart or a styled card becomes an image for a video, a document or a page.

url.description: Page to open. Required for the text path; for a screenshot, either this or `html`

html.description: Inline HTML to render instead of fetching a url — the browser has network, so a CDN <link>/<script> in it loads (KaTeX for a formula, ECharts for a plot). Pair with screenshot:true to get the picture back

screenshot.description: true = return a PNG of the page (or of `selector`) in the media store instead of its text. This is the HTML-to-image path: whatever a browser can draw becomes an image usable in a video layer, a document or a page

viewport.description: 'WxH' render size, 16..4096 per side (default 1280x720). For a formula or a card, size it to the content and let the shot crop to `selector`

scale.description: Device pixel ratio 1..4 (default 2) — 2 keeps text crisp when the image is scaled up in a video

fullPage.description: true = the whole scrollable page rather than the viewport. Ignored when `selector` picks one element

transparent.description: true = do not paint a page background, so the PNG carries alpha. The page's own CSS background still paints — leave it unset for a chalkboard panel, set it to drop a formula onto one

selector.description: CSS selector. Narrows the text path to that element, and the screenshot path to its bounding box

excludeDomains.description: List of domains to exclude when filtering links

links.description: External links on the page (up to 10)

viewport.description: screenshot path — the render size actually used

scale.description: screenshot path — the device pixel ratio actually used
